lines: Adams has played 6 of LA's 10 games and is on IR. LA has a bye in Wk 11, so he won't play that week.
Over his last 3 games he averaged 6.7 targets and 12.1 PPR points a game, down from 8.2 targets and 17.0 points on the season.
The coach said Adams is likely to return after the Green Bay game. Earlier, McVay gave no timetable and was taking it one day at a time.
